scripts.dev: concurrently -k --restart-tries 0 -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexus/api" "npm run dev -w @nexus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexus/api && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @nexus/api" "npm run start -w @nexus/web"
